items.title: Resolve arc lifecycle from the targeted canonical registry
items.why: Operators and agents must discover the current release stage accurately before selecting work. The site is released; reporting UNKNOWN makes information finding unreliable and can select the wrong readiness work.
items.recipe: Resolve the registry from the explicitly targeted project and its Studio Ops sibling, preserve local status fallback and lifecycle conflict evidence, and test sibling, isolated, foreign-target and malformed-registry cases without changing lifecycle records.
